Align Phenotype Vector to Matrix Format for OpenMx

Source: R/buildmxPedigrees.R
alignPhenToMatrix.Rd

This function takes a pedigree data frame, a specified phenotype column, and a vector of IDs to keep, and returns a matrix formatted for use in OpenMx models. The resulting matrix has one row and columns corresponding to the specified IDs, with values taken from the phenotype column of the pedigree.

Usage

alignPhenToMatrix(ped, phenotype, keep_ids, personID = "ID")

Arguments

ped

A data frame representing the pedigree, containing at least the columns specified by phenotype and personID.

phenotype

A character string specifying the column name in ped that contains the phenotype values to be aligned.

keep_ids

A vector of IDs for which the phenotype values should be extracted and aligned. These IDs should correspond to the values in the personID of ped.

personID

A character string specifying the column name in ped that contains the individual IDs. Default is "ID".
